messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired — SLO burn: inference-prod p99 latency > 1.2s (5m window). Trigger: latency_p99_inference_prod_us-east. Pager: eng-oncall-east. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/INC12345>
Sam: acked. I'll take this. pulling dashboards and logs now.
Priya: on standby. any known deploys?
Tomas: no deploys in last 40m, infra looks stable at first glance. checking GPU mem and sidecar queue RT.
Eva: quick prometheus query to check tail shape:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference",env="prod"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Sam: kv-cache hit rate dropped around 17:08; saw a spike in long-context (>1024) requests. p95 stable, p99 climbing.
Lorraine: any customer-facing impact? do we need to page support?
Sam: looks limited to a subset of large requests; no 5xx spike. customers should be degrading UX, not errors.
Priya: can we route heavy long-context traffic to dedicated capacity or lower-quality quantized model as fallback?
Tomas: starting an emergency routing override — switching fallback routing policy for inference-prod to use model-x-q4f in us-east temporarily. I'll post when done.
Tomas: done — forced fallback applied.
Sam: monitoring metrics. p99 started trending down after ~30s. good sign.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by Sam.
Priya: also bumping batch_size from 64->32 for the hot pool to reduce queueing briefly.
Eva: verifying sidecar queue sizes: they dropped ~40% since override.
Lorraine: flagging for customer success — no immediate broad impact, but mention to top customers on watch.
Sam: agreed. creating a short incident note and will follow up with a postmortem if recurrence.
Priya: filing a follow-up ticket: SLO-drift-2025-01-xx with root-candidate: kvcache-eviction-pattern + long-context burst.
Tomas: metrics look stable for 3m. I'll keep the routing override for 10m then roll back if steady.
Sam: thanks — keeping this thread open until back to normal. :thumbsup:
Lorraine: thanks everyone. please add any logs or queries to the ticket.
Sam: closing to watch — will update ticket with links.
